rows.text: calls `001B5FB0()` and tail-jumps to `001B44A0` with `rcx` = that result, `edx` = the incoming `ecx` and `r8d` = the incoming `dl` zero-extended

zeroes qwords `rcx+0` and `rcx+0x10`, stores the 32-bit sum `ecx + edx` zero-extended to qword `+0x18`, and stores the low 32 bits of `rcx` plus 0x30, rounded up to a multiple of 0x10 in 32 bits when not already one, to qword `+0x20`
when `rcx` is non-null calls `002446E0(rcx)`, `002473B0(rcx)` and `002482E0(rcx)` in that order; a null `rcx` returns at once
